title: Set Free
story:
A small bird had accidentally flown into a greenhouse.

It kept fluttering against the glass, trying to escape.

The harder it tried, the more tired it became.

A gardener noticed the frightened bird.

Instead of chasing it, he quietly opened the greenhouse door.

After a few moments, the bird saw the open way.

It flew through the doorway into the open sky.

The cage had never truly been locked.

It simply needed to find the way to freedom.

Many people try to escape guilt, fear, and sin through their own efforts.

But real freedom is found only through Jesus Christ.

By His Spirit, He breaks the power of sin and gives us a new life.

We no longer have to remain trapped.

In Christ, we are truly free.
life_lesson: Jesus sets us free from the power of sin and gives us a new life through His Spirit.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for setting me free through Jesus Christ.

Thank You that I no longer have to live under the power of sin.

Help me to walk each day in the freedom Your Spirit gives.

Let my life reflect the joy and peace of belonging to You.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Is there an area of your life where you still feel trapped?

How does Christ's promise of freedom encourage you today?

What step can you take today to walk more fully in the freedom He gives?
verse: Because through Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit who gives life has set you free from the law of sin and death.
